import sys

MOD = 998244353

def invs(n, mod):
    res = [0] * n
    res[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n):
        res[i] = (mod - (mod // i) * res[mod % i] % mod) % mod
    return res

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    invs_arr = invs(2 * n + 3, MOD)
    p = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(2 * n + 1)]
    p[0][1] = 1  # first is always started
    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        prev_max_running = min(2 * n - i, i)
        max_running = min(2 * n - i - 1, i + 1)
        for j in range(prev_max_running + 1):
            if p[i - 1][j] != 0:
                if j > 0:
                    p[i][j - 1] = (p[i][j - 1] + p[i - 1][j] * j % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n - i] % MOD) % MOD
                if j < max_running:
                    p[i][j + 1] = (p[i][j + 1] + p[i - 1][j] * (2 * n - i - j) % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n - i] % MOD) % MOD
    ans = 0
    for i in range(2 * n):
        for j in range(k, n + 1):
            if p[i][j] == 0:
                continue
            ans = (ans + p[i][j]) % MOD
    ans = ans * l % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n + 1] % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
